RegionBehavior.magic-way.portale: Teleports tokens entering the region to an arrival area, even on another scene. Managed from the Magic Way panel.

notifiche.nome: Notify the GM on every teleport
notifiche.hint: Shows the GM who was teleported, through which portal and to which scene.

effetto.hint: When the portal activates a magic flash appears: the token fades out at departure and fades back in at arrival. Everyone sees it.

coloreEffetto.hint: Colour of the ring and glow shown when the portal activates.

dissolvenza.hint: Players are moved to the arrival scene with a fade transition.

suono.hint: Audio file played for everyone on each teleport. Leave empty for no sound.

segueMaster.hint: After a commanded teleport to another scene, your view moves to the arrival scene too. Personal setting.

lingua.hint: Changes only Magic Way's texts: Foundry's language and other modules stay as they are. Useful if Magic Way does not pick the right language by itself. "Automatic" follows Foundry's language. Changing it reloads the page. Personal setting.

Avvisi.serveMaster: Magic Way: a GM must be connected to complete the teleport.
Avvisi.senzaArrivo: Magic Way: portal "{nome}" has no valid arrival area.
Avvisi.nessunoPresente: Magic Way: nobody to teleport inside portal "{nome}".
Avvisi.nascosta: The area «{nome}» was marked as «Hidden»: in Foundry 14 this switches the portal off. Untick it to make it work (players can't see Magic Way areas anyway).
Avvisi.soloMaster: Magic Way: only the GM can use the portal panel.
Avvisi.errore: Magic Way: the teleport through portal "{nome}" failed (details in the console, F12).
Avvisi.riparati: Magic Way: links repaired {n}, zones recreated {z}.
Avvisi.tuttoAPosto: Magic Way: all links are fine.
Avvisi.mancanti: Magic Way: {n} portals without arrival. Maps to import: {scene}.

Cattura.ingresso: Drag on the map to draw the ENTRANCE area (a single click = one space).
Cattura.arrivo: Open the arrival scene (or stay here) and drag to draw the ARRIVAL area.
Cattura.ridisegna: Open the right scene and drag to redraw the area "{nome}".

Pannello.apriTuttiHint: Opens every open/closed portal (only those listed).
Pannello.chiudiTuttiHint: Closes every open/closed portal (only those listed).
Pannello.vuoto: No portals yet. Press "New portal" to create one.
Pannello.passanoHint: Who gets teleported: only player tokens, only monsters and NPCs run by the GM, or everyone.
Pannello.soloArrivo: Arrival only: nobody leaves from here.
Pannello.creaRitornoHint: Turns this area into a portal back to the other one too.
Pannello.trascina: Drag from here onto a zone on the left to put the portal in it
Pannello.vai: Show this area on the map
Pannello.ridisegna: Redraw this area (drag on the map, even on another scene)
Pannello.nomeHint: Name of this area: type your own
Pannello.riparaHint: After importing maps or adventures from another world: finds arrivals by their codes, repairs the links and recreates the zones. It also runs by itself at startup and after every import.
Pannello.arrivoMancante: Arrival "{nome}" not found: also import the map "{scena}" and press Repair links.
Pannello.arrivoMancanteGenerico: This portal has no arrival area: redraw it or delete the link.

Creazione.spiegazione: After "Next" drag on the map to draw the entrance area (as large as you want, snapped to the grid; a single click takes one space), then open the arrival scene (or stay here) and draw the arrival area the same way. Areas are invisible to players: you see them coloured only on the Regions layer.

Elimina.domanda: Delete the link {nome} and its areas?

destinazione.label: Arrival area
destinazione.hint: The region where tokens appear (drop it here or paste its UUID). It can be on another scene.

modalita.label: Mode
modalita.hint: Free: tokens pass at once. Open/closed: only while the GM keeps it open. On command: only when the GM presses "Teleport now".

passano.label: Who passes
passano.hint: Only player tokens, only monsters and NPCs run by the GM, or everyone.

Zone.eliminaDomanda: Delete zone "{nome}"? Its portals and sub-zones move to the parent zone (or are left without a zone).
Zone.trascina: Click to filter (sub-zones included). Drag a portal here to put it in this zone, or another zone to make it a sub-zone of this one.
Zone.bloccate: Moving zones is locked: click to unlock it. Portals can always be dragged into zones.
Zone.sbloccate: Moving zones is unlocked: drag a zone onto another to move it. Click to lock it.
Zone.trascinaTutti: Shows every portal. Drag a portal here to remove its zone, or a zone to move it back to the top level.
